EasyJet nears agreement on potential takeover by US investment firm

Low-cost airline EasyJet has indicated it will accept a takeover offer from US investment firm Castlelake, following several previous rejections. The proposed deal, valued at £5.5 billion, would result in Britain's largest low-cost carrier being taken private. This agreement in principle marks a significant development after multiple rejected proposals.
